cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Remember Me Correctly
cards.instruction: Create small tests of whether someone remembers your preferences, stories, or shared history.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before you take the tea through, which cup is mine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you just take one? Everyone's waiting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Twelve years of breakfast together. Which one have I always used?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The blue one. Your name's underneath.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Correct, but turn it upright. How much milk? I haven't written that on the handle.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 withholds normal tea progress for a test, A3 insists on remembered preference and A5 grades the label-assisted answer before changing to milk, sustaining superior examiner control.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 impatience causes A3 history prompt; B4 label clue causes A5 unlabelled milk test. A5 turn upright supplies current orientation; it does not establish a spill or filled cup.

relationship.evidence: B2 guests are waiting and B4 uses an available identifying clue, credible attempts to finish service rather than pass a relationship exam.

heightening.evidence: B4 correct answer may come from a label, so A5 asks a preference not printed anywhere, heightening the memory demand.

specificity.evidence: A1 tea service, B4 cup label and A5 milk question establish a playable task. Filling state is immaterial unless a spill is asserted, which none is.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 milk not written on handle earns the test extension from B4 name underneath; the prefixed A3 sentence remains wordy.

coach2.missing: No essential fact must be invented; precise filling state does not affect the interaction.
coach2.firstDefect: Earlier original assessment over-penalized harmless cup-state ambiguity by imagining a filled inverted cup. That unsupported inference is withdrawn, with history retained.
